fusions.name: End of the Trail
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy up to 6 tiles away that is at or below 25% health, which deals 18 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Drumming Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps on the strands around you, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stuns each for 1 second and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Single File
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 8 seconds, and you all move 10% faster while veiled. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Fed by the Road
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your attacks heal you for 15% of the damage they deal for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
